name: tpl-response-2-goal
task: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards. Then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(has_key, door_open) captures 'while holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards' (pending until the door opens, persisting even if the key is dropped), and the hard Existence(at_goal) commands 'reach the goal'. The ordering of at_goal after door_open is already guaranteed by the environment (at_goal cannot become true before door_open), so no extra Precedence is needed.

texts: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&!door_open&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&has_key) -> u3
(u0, at_goal&door_open) -> u2
(u1, !at_goal&door_open) -> u0
(u1, at_goal&!door_open) -> u3
(u1, at_goal&door_open) -> u2
(u3, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
